name: chronicle-financial-processor
description: Chronicle - Financial document processing and AI analysis platform

scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.backend:install: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:install
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm start to begin development.'

author: Chronicle Team
